localBiteReport: The fall transition is underway on Choctawhatchee Bay as of this week (September 18–24, 2026). Water temperature is 86°F. Capt. Adam Schroeder of Ignite The Bite Charters in Destin reports that bait is now abundant throughout the bay, and that abundance is directly fueling the best inshore bite he has seen all year — redfish, trout, and flounder are all active and accessible. Redfish are the standout species, with slot fish and larger bulls spread from the Destin pass through the main bay system; live scaled sardines, shrimp, and croakers around structure are the top presentations, with the bite heavily influenced by tide movement. Trout and flounder are also in the mix, and anglers should plan trips around tidal windows — fish may sit on structure for hours before turning on for a short, productive feeding window when the current hits the right stage.
